the addition of oleic acid or polyoxyethylene sorbitol monooleate (Tween 80) to the growth medium of lactic acid streptococci and lactobacilli results in a pronounced increase in the ratio of the unsaturated to saturated cellular fatty acids.

The main takeaway from our work is that
lactic acid bacteria grown in the presence Tween 80 (which increases unsaturated fatty acids) are more tolerant to freezing than those grown in its absence.
